question: All India Padmashree Mohammad Shahid Invitation Prize Money Men's Hockey Tournament 2023 was held in _________ city of Uttar Pradesh.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Varanasi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **All India Padmashree Mohammad Shahid Invitation Prize Money Men's Hockey Tournament 2023** was held in **Varanasi**, Uttar Pradesh.
 
• This tournament is named in honor of the legendary Indian hockey player Padmashree Mohammad Shahid, who was known for his exceptional dribbling skills.
 
• Varanasi, one of the oldest cities in the world, is not only a cultural and spiritual hub but also supports various sports activities, including hockey.
 
• The event attracted numerous teams from across the country, promoting the sport of hockey and encouraging young talent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padmashree Mohammad Shahid** was an Indian field hockey player who was part of the team that won the gold medal at the 1980 Moscow Olympics.
 
• He was awarded the prestigious **Padma Shri** by the Government of India in recognition of his contributions to the sport.
 
• Varanasi, also known as Kashi or Benares, is situated on the banks of the river Ganges and is renowned for its temples, ghats, and cultural heritage.
 
• The city has produced several notable athletes and continues to be a prominent center for various sports activities.
